failure_attribution: The shuffle generator reversed only the order of 1 MiB blocks. Each specialist archive is smaller than one block, so its shuffled copy was byte-identical and legitimately installed. This is a hostile-control construction defect, not a capability, adapter, host, isolation, semantic, or mathematical failure.
allowed_code_change: In _mutate_shuffle_equal_size, reverse bytes inside each emitted block in addition to reversing block order.
layercake_rescreen_scope: Only equal-size random and shuffled corruption rejection for the four exact packages; inherit all other immutable observations and gates from the complete failed result.
qwen_and_pythia_scope: Run the complete preregistered matrix with the corrected hostile control because no complete receiver result exists for either host.
decision_rule: The repair passes only if every equal-size random and shuffled copy has a hash different from its source and every package is rejected before execution. Any other LayerCake gate remains exactly as recorded in the failed result.
